title: Dental Implants vs Dentures: Pros, Costs & Comparison
seoTitle: Dental Implants vs Dentures: Costs, Pros and Cons
seoDescription: Compare implants and dentures on stability, bone health, lifespan, cost and upkeep so you can choose with confidence. Consult our Santa Clarita team.
excerpt: A side-by-side look at implants and dentures: function, bone preservation, longevity, typical U.S. costs and the questions to ask before you decide.
keyTakeaways: Implants are fixed to the jawbone, which gives stability and helps slow the bone loss that dentures do not prevent.
The article cites typical U.S. costs of $3,000 to $6,000 per single implant and $600 to $8,000 for complete dentures.
Dentures usually need relining or replacement every 5 to 10 years; implant fixtures can last decades with care.
Candidacy depends on bone volume, medical history (diabetes, smoking, radiation) and commitment to hygiene.
Implant-retained overdentures snap onto 2 to 4 implants and sit between conventional dentures and fixed arches on cost and stability.
